## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] New or changed calculator logic has tests (including bad input)
- [ ] Assumptions are visible in the UI; no "guaranteed/accurate/official" claims
- [ ] New tool: catalog, `TOOL_CONTENT`, metadata layout and OG image added
- [ ] Privacy policy updated if tracking or third-party scripts changed
